evidence: decorative_mascot: Data does nothing but stand and slide along the bars — he drifts from the 2030 bar (hook@0.3) up to the 2019 bar (seg0:end) to the 2014 bar (seg1:start), then simply stands beside a column at seg2:start and seg3:mid; no setup->action->payoff is ever tied to 62M, 22% or 1%.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg1:mid and seg1:end the scene title "the world's growing e-waste pile" is overprinted by the series label "2030 (projected) 82M" and by a second header "the data stops here", with the mascot parked on top of the title's first characters; the line chart itself occupies a narrow strip of an otherwise empty frame.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The projection scene composes its own header and its end-of-series annotation in the same band as the inherited scene title, with no measured collision test or reserved title zone, and the mascot is placed at a fixed top-left anchor independent of where text sits.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Lay out seg1 so exactly one header occupies the title band: drop or reposition the duplicate "the data stops here"/series annotation below the plot, keep the mascot clear of any text bounding box, and scale the measured/projected line to fill the frame height instead of a corner strip.
